# Decor Construction Chemicals

> Product information for Decor Construction Chemicals, a construction chemicals catalogue. The site provides product descriptions and pack details and accepts order inquiries through WhatsApp.

## Pages

- [Home and house-area recommendations](https://molvisahab.github.io/decor-website/)
- [Product catalogue](https://molvisahab.github.io/decor-website/products.html)

## Products

- [Decor Proof 700](https://molvisahab.github.io/decor-website/products/proof-700.html): Integral waterproofing powder.
- [Decor SBR Latex 775](https://molvisahab.github.io/decor-website/products/sbr-latex-775.html): Bonding agent and admixture.
- [Decor Seal 777](https://molvisahab.github.io/decor-website/products/seal-777.html): Two-component waterproofing kit.
- [Decor WP 781](https://molvisahab.github.io/decor-website/products/wp-781.html): Flexible waterproofing coating.
- [Decor PU Sealant](https://molvisahab.github.io/decor-website/products/pu-sealant.html): Polyurethane joint sealant.
- [Decor Termi Fix](https://molvisahab.github.io/decor-website/products/termi-fix.html): Anti-termite treatment.
